app.name: RevenueDot
app.short_description: The requester's subscriptions, entitlements, refunds and open tickets from RevenueDot.
app.long_description: Shows the ticket requester's subscription status, active entitlements, plan, renewal date, total spent, refund requests and open Customer Center tickets from RevenueDot, looked up by the requester's email.
app.installation_instructions: Enter your RevenueDot API URL (https://api.revenuedot.app on RevenueDot Cloud), your project ID, and a secret API key with the customer_information:customers:read permission. A self-hosted server must also be added to domainWhitelist in manifest.json. Guide: https://revenuedot.app/docs/guides/support-integrations#zendesk

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.helpText: Project settings in the RevenueDot dashboard.

secret_key.label: Secret API key
secret_key.helpText: A secret key (sk_…) with customer_information:customers:read. Stored by Zendesk as a secure setting; the browser never sees it.
